Bounded RAM capture: one final file write, disabled by default
Skip managed INI temporary-file/replacement when exact current defaults already exist at EOF
not_implemented: Decoded PSARC block cache: defer memory budget and policy until runtime I/O frequency is measured
Shader filesystem and save I/O telemetry are separate from archive counters
